facts.fact: TechCentral reports that South Africa's Electronic Communications and Transactions Act of 2002 is the law under which the South African Accreditation Authority accredits providers whose signatures qualify as advanced electronic signatures; the document gives no date for the statement, so the published date 2026-09-11 is used.
facts.system: Electronic Communications and Transactions Act of 2002

facts.fact: TechCentral reports that under the Electronic Communications and Transactions Act the South African Accreditation Authority accredits advanced electronic signature providers and that three hold accreditation: Altron Security, TrustFactory and Impression Signatures; no accreditation dates are given, so the published date 2026-09-11 is used.
facts.system: Electronic Communications and Transactions Act of 2002
